audit.whatIsWrong: 'His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down.' was the whole interaction note. The range mismatch that defines this lane was never stated.
audit.why: Feral Scream is a 300-range cone; Winds of War reaches 825 and Justice Punch 650. A Galio who never steps in is never silenced, so the entire matchup is about the one ability that forces him inside 300 — Justice Punch, 11s at rank 1. Once he is there, the silence cancels the Shield of Durand charge outright, meaning the taunt never fires and its 18s is spent for nothing. The Galio-side audit is built around the same 300-range fact from the other direction and reaches the mirrored conclusion.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream reaches only 300, but inside it the silence cancels his Shield of Durand channel and stops Justice Punch cold.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere and Feast was 'your committal tool'.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s, Winds of War 11/10/9/8/7s, Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14s, Hero's Entrance 180/160/140s against Feast's 80s. The 180s ultimate is why his level-6 spike is a map spike and not a lane spike — he cannot repeat it in this lane.
audit.corrected: Windows keyed to Justice Punch at 11s, Shield of Durand at 18s, Hero's Entrance at 180s versus Feast at 80s.

audit.why: Skill at level 1, Cho'Gath at 2-3, skill at 4-5 and 6, Cho'Gath both item rows — identical row for row to the Galio-side chart, and consistent with 55.15% over 466 games. Worth noting the Galio page's own report[2].t prose describes the opposite split from its own enums, so that direction has an internal contradiction mine does not.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that Cho'Gath cannot leave once Justice Punch lands behind him.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/_missing/chogath.json flags terrain-cuts-retreat for Galio: Justice Punch steps back, charges, and knocks up the first champion it reaches, and Cho'Gath has no dash to answer being cut off. Flash is for the wall, not for the damage.
audit.corrected: Justice Punch cuts your retreat and you have no dash — Flash the wall, not the damage.

notes: The Galio-side page claims in content.late that this lane 'is lost on stats (35% WR)' while my packet has Cho'Gath at 55.15% over 466 games. Those two numbers are roughly consistent in direction, so the pages agree here — worth recording only because the same kind of sample gap went the other way on akshan. Following the Galio-side audit I made no grounding claim for Rupture and asserted no damage type for Rupture or Vorpal Spikes: Riot's text gives a damage type only for Feral Scream (magic) and Feast (true).
